translated_title: Under Felipe Calderón, the Greatest US Intervention in Mexico
original_title: Con Felipe Calderón, la mayor intromisión de EU en México
author: Nancy Flores
meta_description: Declassified U.S. cables show how, under the cover of the Mérida Initiative, Washington's DEA, FBI and CIA took control of Mexico's security strategy during Felipe Calderón's term — the deepest US intervention in the country's recent history.
